criteria.text:
A diagnosis whose fix is "grant `read`/`glob`/`bash`" produces an **applyable** patch targeting
   `corePermissionsJson`, and approving it merges those keys into the profile's existing map without
   dropping unrelated keys (e.g. an existing `bash` pattern map).
criteria.test_id: issue-config-doctor-core-permissions-c1: core-permission diagnosis resolves to an applyable deep-merge scope patch

criteria.text:
Approving such a proposal projects correctly into `~/.config/opencode/agents/<id>.md` frontmatter
   and survives `revert` back to the before-snapshot.
criteria.test_id: issue-config-doctor-core-permissions-c2: approved core-permission patch projects and reverts exactly

criteria.text:
A patch that puts `bash`/`read`/`edit` into `allowedMcpsJson`, or an MCP server name into
   `corePermissionsJson`, is **rejected at extract time** with a clear message.
criteria.test_id: issue-config-doctor-core-permissions-c3: cross-layer scope names are rejected with a clear validation message

criteria.text:
A profile that already has the permissions in question no longer generates a scope proposal
   claiming it has none. Regression test using the real `verification-gate` shape above.
criteria.test_id: issue-config-doctor-core-permissions-c4: verification-gate core permissions are visible to diagnosis

criteria.text: N simultaneous `Error: Aborted` sessions produce one external-noop signal, not N scope proposals.
criteria.test_id: issue-config-doctor-core-permissions-c5: same-window abort batch collapses to one external-noop signal

criteria.text:
Existing `allowedMcpsJson` / `allowedSkillsJson` scope patches keep working unchanged —
   `org_proposals_routes.test.ts` and `workflow_signal_generator_diagnose.test.ts` stay green.
criteria.test_id: issue-config-doctor-core-permissions-c6: legacy MCP and skill allowlist patches remain applyable
